summary: PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering (University of Oklahoma, 2025) with undergraduate teaching experience in computer programming, communication systems and wireless communications. Additional experience includes engineering laboratories, student-project mentoring, and research supervision. Specialization in AI/ML for wireless networks, data-driven network optimization and applied telecommunications engineering through research at the University of Oklahoma and industry work at AT&T Labs, Futurewei and AT&T. Interested in supporting undergraduate lectures, precepts, laboratories, office hours and assessment in computing, networking and data-intensive ECE.
